claims.text: the hit set holds every reference to afk-bin, place_entry over the name forms this pass searched

The install loop runs the steps uv, python, environment (the uv sync), launcher (place_entry), path in that order; place_entry runs only after the sync step exits 0, so a launcher write inside place_entry follows the sync and the afk-python write.

On a compatible environment uv 0.12.23 sync keeps the existing environment (ProjectEnvironment::Existing) and clears no directory, so afk-bin and its files survive; package changes go through the installer, whose uninstall reads only the distributions' own records (that crate not read).

On an incompatible environment (a changed Python pin fails the --python request, a pyvenv.cfg version conflict, a broken interpreter link) uv sync calls clear_virtualenv on UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT, which deletes every entry under it recursively, afk-bin with afk-python, afk-team and afk-team.cmd included, then recreates the venv; this happens inside the environment step, before place_entry rewrites afk-bin.
No repository code runs uv venv, --clear or UV_VENV_CLEAR against the environment, and uv_env strips every UV_ variable outside UV_KEEP, which holds no clear setting, before the sync runs.

claims.text: On Windows a rebuild cannot delete afk-bin while a hook or the MCP server runs afk-python.exe from it: uv's self-delete guard covers only uv's own executable. Setup's own interpreter is uv's managed CPython started by the bootstrap, so setup itself holds no afk-bin file open.

The layout key launcher names afk-python and is read by setup_secrets.py:45, the stamp, check and the tests; the afk-team launcher needs a layout key of its own, or every reader of launcher changes meaning.
The SDD has no afk-team launcher text yet, and its E9 id already names message delivery, while the signed HL-5 row calls the launcher write new effect E9.

Whether cmd.exe keeps a running afk-team.cmd open, which would block its staged replacement or a rebuild on Windows: not probed.

check's uv sync --check --offline never clears or recreates the environment root: uv 0.12.23 maps --check to DryRun::Check, whose enabled() is true, so get_or_init returns a compatible environment as is and, for an incompatible one, builds a temporary environment in the cache (WouldReplace) instead of calling clear_virtualenv; afk-bin survives every check.

README.md:350 says the AFK Python runtime is exposed only as the afk-python command; an afk-team launcher in afk-bin makes that false, and FRESHNESS.md:69's same-commit list (MANIFEST P1, both bootstraps, four runtime tests) does not name README.md, so the registry does not prompt the fix.

/afk:setup audit section 8 (AUDIT.md:142-149) enumerates the P1 check's fail kinds, all about afk-python; once check reports a missing or stale afk-team launcher as the signed HL6-10 and HL5-7 rows require, that list misses the new finding.

The team-script invocation sites name afk-python "${AFK_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/afk-team.py", never afk-bin: permission.py:28 (INVOCATION, and the verb commands at :69), claude.sh:78 (the allow rule), entry.py:237 (the agent prompt), afk-team.py:4 (usage) and test_team_entry.py:368. Writing the launcher leaves them unchanged; they change only with the separate switch to the rule Bash(afk-team *).

No shipped command competes with an afk-team in afk-bin: the plugin tracks no bin/ folder (git ls-files -- bin is empty), the other afk-team tokens in hooks/ and scripts/ are the run-root folder .claude/afk-team (entry.py:85) and stderr prefixes (entry.py:351, :353), and the PATH builder that keeps afk-bin (plugin-source-gates.sh:224-235) resolves only afk-python.

Apart from uv's environment replacement, no repository code deletes afk-bin: every recursive delete under scripts, hooks, skills, adapters and mcp-servers targets a temporary, lock, build or fixture folder, and the only code deriving the afk data folder is layout() (python_runtime.py:129-144), the two bootstraps and the CI workflows, none of which deletes it.
